headline: Steady quarter; margin resilience drives earnings beat

highlights: Key Points  JUBI’s 2QFY27 standalone revenue grew 11.5% YoY (+2.0% QoQ) to Rs18.9bn, in line with our estimate and 2.0% ahead of consensus, supported by steady store additions (standalone network at 2,611 stores; +80 QoQ/+290 YoY).

Consolidated revenue rose 11.8% YoY to Rs26.1bn.  Gross margin held at 75.5% (+110bps YoY, flat QoQ), and standalone EBITDA grew 12.4% YoY to Rs3.7bn, with EBITDA margin at 19.8% (+16bps YoY/+30bps QoQ), beating our/consensus estimates by 2.1%/3.1%.

APAT grew 7.6% YoY to Rs725mn, 5.0%/10.1% above our/consensus estimates, although higher depreciation (+14.3% YoY) and finance costs (+13.0% YoY) absorbed part of the operating gains.  We raise our FY27/FY28 revenue estimates by 1.3%/1.5% and EBITDA estimates by 2.8%/0.9%, factoring in the better-than-expected 2QFY27 margin delivery (FY27E EBITDA margin raised by 30bps to 19.3%; FY28E broadly unchanged at 20.0%).
Consequently, we raise our APAT estimates by 1.8%/2.5% for FY27/FY28.
valuation: This implies a target EV of Rs340.8bn and a unchanged target price of Rs510/share (earlier Rs510).
Offering 11% upside from the CMP of Rs459; we maintain our HOLD rating on the stock. 2QFY27 standalone performance update: JUBI’s standalone topline grew 11.5% YoY (+2.0% QoQ) to Rs18.9bn.

Outlook • Management’s near-term priorities are delivering 5–7% LFL growth in FY27, reviving the DITA channel, scaling Popeyes towards a Rs10bn run-rate, restoring COFFY’s value positioning, and recovering the residual margin headwind.
